source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of ethics in terms of use (PDF 178).

blocks.text: Terms of Use ke ethical (akhlaqi, yaani sahi aur ghalat wale) pehlu mein teen cheezein shamil hain: fairness (insaf), transparency (kuch na chhupana) aur user ke rights ki respect (izzat). Companies ke liye zaroori hai ke un ki terms saaf aur seedhi hon, bila wajah mushkil ya deceptive (dhoka dene wali) na hon. Provider ki ethical zimmedari hai ke user poori tarah samjhe ke woh kin terms ko maan raha hai, na ke zaroori baatein lambe ya uljhe hue documents mein chhupa di jayein.

Misal: Pakistan mein jab koi online course mein sign up kare, to terms mein saaf likha ho ke certificate milega ya nahi, personal data kaise sambhala jayega, aur koi additional fees (alag se lagne wali fees) hai ya nahi. Ethical taur par bohat zaroori hai ke educational platforms user ko yeh dhoka na dein ke course muft hai jab ke asal mein us mein hidden costs (chhupe hue kharche) hon.

blocks.prompt: Zaroori baaton ko lambe aur uljhe hue document mein chhupana unethical (ghalat, akhlaq ke khilaf) kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke user us shart ko soch samajh kar maan hi nahi sakta jo use aasani se na mile ya samajh na aaye. Is tarah provider ko be-insafi wala faida milta hai, aur yeh fairness aur transparency ke khilaf hai, jo kitab ke mutabiq ethical terms ki bunyad (base) hain.

items: Ethical Terms of Use: fair, transparent, user ke rights ki respect; saaf aur seedhi, dhoke wali nahi.
Online course: certificate, data ka istemal aur additional fees saaf likhi hon; chhupe kharchon wale course ko muft na dikhayein.
